items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: And then after I left that’s when Sal Nistico came on the band

ctx.x: You know not really. You know at that time I was young and just wanted to see the country and I was able to do that. I was actually being a professional in something I never thought I could do and then here I was doing it. So to me I was just out having a great

time, playing music that at the time I said if this is all I did the rest of my life — play this music — that’s all I’d ever want to do because the music was so much fun. I never played lead although the first time I was on Woody’s band I was playing like I said on one of the ends, Don was on the other end. And then Woody broke the band up because they just didn’t have any takers for booking the band at that time, so they disbanded the band. Bill Chase and Woody stayed on and they had a little quintet. And I went…
